## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to point at the page where a licence to use the asset can be acquired ([schema:acquireLicensePage](https://schema.org/acquireLicensePage)) — the purchase or request URL for a paid or gated work.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the licence document or its text ([`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md), [`gmeow:licenseText`](gmeow-licenseText.md)) and avoid it for a freely-usable asset, which is better signalled by [`gmeow:isAccessibleForFree`](gmeow-isAccessibleForFree.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:acquireLicensePage`](gmeow-acquireLicensePage.md) on the asset to the acquisition URL; pair it with [`gmeow:isAccessibleForFree`](gmeow-isAccessibleForFree.md) false when the asset requires a purchased licence.

### Examples

- ex:stockPhoto [`gmeow:acquireLicensePage`](gmeow-acquireLicensePage.md) "https://example.com/license/stock-photo"^^[xsd:anyURI.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#anyURI.)
